labels.reason: Table name derived from the WebDAV request path is concatenated into a DESCRIBE statement with no validation or quoting.
backup_name is chosen by the local CLI operator for their own storage directory, not supplied by an untrusted party.
scoped_group comes from developer-defined finder scope options that are documented raw SQL fragments, not end-user input.
pri_key_value and table_name from the WebDAV request path are concatenated directly into a SELECT with no escaping.
The blob key is server-generated as tenant/secure-token and the tenant is the application's current tenant, so the joined path is not attacker-controlled.
The response is JSON-encoded via MapToJson with a redirect URI already validated against the registered callback, so no HTML injection sink exists here.
The ZipSlip containment check on fullPath immediately precedes the os.Create call.
When no CA file is configured the consumer silently sets VERIFY_NONE, disabling TLS certificate verification by default.
The marked SQL literal only interpolates internal field/table names and the session user id, no request data.
output_path from module params reaches os.makedirs before the weak '..' check, and absolute paths are never restricted.
The execute call is parameterized but the query text is built by _get_batch_list_namespaces_queries, which is not shown.
insert_fixture is used only for test fixture loading with quoted table name and fixture-quoted values.
The joined path is immediately checked with pathContainedIn against the repo root.
type_condition interpolates quoted identifiers and STI class names, which are code-defined and not user input.
Generic mkdir helper with no evidence of untrusted input reaching root/name in the shown code.
The marked line passes a route parameter to a validation function and is not a SQL sink.
Whether tmpPath can incorporate attacker-influenced values such as image keys depends on callers not shown.
group is a developer-supplied find option documented as a raw SQL fragment, not end-user input in the shown code.
The client filename from $_FILES is already basename-stripped by PHP and targetPath/name are developer-supplied.
The DELETE uses sqlx.In placeholders with bound arguments.
uid must resolve to a valid Sketchfab API download and the file is written as uid.zip inside a fresh mkdtemp directory, so it is not a realistic traversal.
Plaintext gRPC is only used when the operator explicitly configures a grpc:// URL, documented as non-production.
For grpcs connections without a supplied TLS config, inter-control-plane gRPC sets InsecureSkipVerify, allowing MITM.
The donation company name from the database (user-entered, including via public donation forms) is printed into HTML without escaping.
The username tool argument is interpolated into a shell command for exec; double quotes do not prevent $() or quote-breaking injection.
sessionId from the query string is joined into a file path without validation, allowing ../ traversal to read other .jsonl files.
Block IDs are concatenated into SQL with double quotes, but whether IDs are validated or externally controllable is not shown.
serviceName from tool input is interpolated unquoted into a shell command run via exec.
Developer conversion utility script that loads a locally supplied checkpoint path; tooling-only.
pri_key_value from the request path is concatenated inside quotes into a SELECT without escaping.
The helper wraps already quoted identifiers and a where clause built from sanitized conditions.
serviceName from tool input is interpolated unquoted into a docker restart shell command.
Client certificates are requested but not verified (RequestClientCert with a no-op VerifyConnection), yet peer certificate identity is used later for authentication.
insert_fixture is test-fixture-only code with a quoted table name and quoted fixture values.
Filesystem::link is a framework helper whose paths are supplied by developer code such as storage:link, not end users.
An explicit model-artifact load API intended for the user's own saved models; no untrusted input source shown.
senderId is a typed int formatted with %d and the message is escaped.
The '..' substring check does not stop absolute output paths, so arbitrary file writes remain possible from module params.
Rasa model archives (which can be fetched from remote storage or model servers) are deserialized with pickle, allowing code execution from a malicious model.
The marked SQL line contains only internal field names and the session user id.
LDAP directory attribute values are printed into HTML (and attributes) without escaping.
This is DOMPurify's internal parsing of dirty markup into an inert document prior to sanitization, not an output sink.
getFile is reached through the minify handler, which imports and applies sanitizePathname to the request path.
locale and default_locale come from the application's configured locale set and collation from config, not raw user input.
merged_conditions is built by merge_conditions, which sanitizes each condition.
The marked line of the subquery template contains only internal field and table names.
